tasks.title: Implement JWT token generation endpoint
tasks.description: Create a FastAPI endpoint at POST /auth/login that accepts username and password, validates credentials against Supabase users table, and returns JWT access token and refresh token. Use RS256 algorithm for signing. Access tokens expire in 15 minutes, refresh tokens in 7 days. Store refresh tokens in Redis with automatic expiry.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint accepts username and password in request body
Returns valid JWT access token on successful authentication
Returns refresh token in response payload
Access tokens expire after 15 minutes
Refresh tokens expire after 7 days
Invalid credentials return 401 status code
Refresh tokens stored in Redis with TTL

tasks.title: Implement token refresh endpoint
tasks.description: Create POST /auth/refresh endpoint that accepts a refresh token, validates it against Redis, and returns a new access token. Invalidate the old refresh token and issue a new one (refresh token rotation). Handle expired/invalid refresh tokens gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint accepts refresh token in request body
Returns new access token if refresh token valid
Issues new refresh token (rotation)
Invalidates old refresh token in Redis
Returns 401 for expired or invalid refresh tokens
New refresh token stored in Redis with TTL

tasks.title: Create login form component
tasks.description: Build a React login form component using shadcn/ui form components. Include fields for username and password, client-side validation, and error display. On submit, call the /auth/login endpoint and store tokens in httpOnly cookies. Display loading state during authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: Form includes username and password fields
Client-side validation for required fields
Submits credentials to /auth/login endpoint
Stores access and refresh tokens in httpOnly cookies
Shows loading spinner during authentication
Displays error messages for failed login
Redirects to dashboard on successful login

tasks.title: Implement authentication middleware
tasks.description: Create FastAPI middleware that validates JWT access tokens on protected routes. Extract token from Authorization header, verify signature, check expiration, and attach user info to request context. Return 401 for missing/invalid tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Middleware extracts JWT from Authorization header
Validates token signature using RS256 public key
Checks token expiration
Attaches user info to request context for valid tokens
Returns 401 for missing tokens
Returns 401 for invalid or expired tokens
Allows requests to public routes without token

tasks.title: Add token refresh logic to frontend
tasks.description: Implement axios interceptor that detects 401 responses, attempts to refresh the access token using the refresh token, and retries the original request. If refresh fails, redirect to login page. Handle token refresh race conditions (multiple concurrent requests).
acceptanceCriteria: Axios interceptor detects 401 responses
Calls /auth/refresh endpoint with refresh token
Retries original request with new access token
Handles concurrent requests during refresh
Redirects to login if refresh fails
Updates httpOnly cookies with new tokens

tasks.title: Create logout endpoint
tasks.description: Implement POST /auth/logout endpoint that invalidates the refresh token in Redis and clears authentication cookies. Frontend should call this endpoint and redirect to login page.
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint invalidates refresh token in Redis
Returns success response
Frontend clears httpOnly cookies
Frontend redirects to login page after logout

tasks.title: Add comprehensive error handling and logging
tasks.description: Implement structured logging for all authentication operations. Log successful logins, failed attempts, token refreshes, and logout events. Include user IDs, timestamps, and IP addresses. Add rate limiting to prevent brute force attacks (5 failed attempts per IP per minute).
acceptanceCriteria: Structured logging for all auth operations
Logs include user ID, timestamp, IP address
Rate limiting prevents brute force (5 attempts/min)
Rate limit violations logged
Successful logins logged
Failed login attempts logged with reason
Token refresh events logged
